example.title: Louis Morgensen-William Rowan Building, 224-226 State Street
example.source: HABS WI-315 (photos via Wikimedia Commons mirror of HABS WIS,51-RACI,7-)

brief: Two-storey brick double-storefront commercial building in Racine's Old Main district with patterned brick panels and a corbelled parapet, arched upper windows each under a striped fabric awning, and a modern shopfront with a flat sign band; low one-storey commercial buildings continue down the street toward the river bridge.

storefronts.sign: ROYAL PRINTING - WEDDING INVITATIONS - BUSINESS CARDS
